title: 第17章 我的刀也未尝不利第18章 我们来的路上看到了周暗的尸体
lines: 通不过，那就……滚！”
缥缈天梯之巅，距离终点仅剩了十步之遥。
萧诺再度被拦住了去路。
“是唐千……”
天梯顶峰，几位缥缈宗的长老相互对视一眼，也是看到了对方眼中的那一抹疑惑。
“今日的挑战中还有最后一关吗？”
“没有吧！
不清楚啊！”
“之前并没有。”
几人一合计，顿时明白，这最后一关显然是有人临时设下的。
那个人不用想也知道，绝对是周羽芙，周长老。
眼前这位唐千，便是周长老的弟子之一。
他拦住萧诺的目的，无非就是想要给后面的周暗，良姿二人争取时间。
天梯之上。
萧诺冷冷的盯着上方之人。
“在云峰台的时候，负责接待的长老貌似并未说过还有这一关……”
“你可以选择不闯！”
唐千没有想要解释的意思，他是内门天才，更是长老的弟子，没有必要向一个新人解释。
萧诺第一反应就是受到了刁难。
其暗自冷笑：“想必是有人内定了这第一，自己怕是动了某些人的蛋糕，所以才会被阻挠。”
闯吗？
当然要闯！
自己已经走到这一步了，没有必要退后。
哪怕是在被夺走天凰血的那三年，萧诺都不曾想过后退，更别说现在……
“只要战胜你，就能过去，对吗？”
萧诺沉声道。
唐千面露轻蔑笑意，眼前这个人，还真是不知天高地厚。
战胜自己？他配吗？
不仅仅是唐千，就连峰顶上的那些长老都觉得萧诺想多了。
唐千的实力已经达到了筑基境半步五重。
先不说两人本身的差距，就凭萧诺横跨一百二十里的山路，再加上登上这天梯大道，体能怕是早就消耗的差不多了。
对方要是聪明一点的话，连动手的念头都不要有。
老老实实的等待周暗，良姿前来，然后自己拿个第三名，才是正确的选择。
content_en:
If you can't pass, then...get out! "
At the top of the misty ladder, there are only ten steps left from the end.
Xiao Nuo was blocked again.
"It's Tang Qian..."
At the top of the ladder, several elders of the Piaomiao Sect looked at each other and saw the doubt in each other's eyes.
“Is there one final level in today’s challenge? "
"No!
Not sure! "
“It didn’t happen before. "
"..."
When several people put it together, they immediately understood that this last level was obviously set up temporarily by someone.
You don't need to think about it to know that person is definitely Zhou Yufu, Elder Zhou.
The Tang Qian in front of him is one of Elder Zhou's disciples.
His purpose in stopping Xiao Nuo was simply to buy time for Zhou An and Liangzi who were behind him.
On the ladder to heaven.
Xiao Nuo stared coldly at the person above.
"When we were at Yunfeng Terrace, the elder in charge of the reception didn't seem to have mentioned that there was still this level..."
"You can choose not to break in! "
Tang Qian had no intention of explaining. He was a genius in the inner sect and a disciple of an elder. There was no need to explain to a newcomer.
Xiao Nuo's first reaction was to be made things difficult for him.
He sneered secretly: "Someone must have decided to take the first place, and I was afraid that I would mess with someone's cake, so I was blocked. "
Break in?
Of course I have to break in!
I have come this far, there is no need to step back.
Even in the three years when Tianhuang's blood was taken away, Xiao Nuo never thought about retreating, let alone now...
"As long as I defeat you, I can get over it, right? "
Xiao Nuo said in a deep voice.
"Hmph! "
Tang Qian had a contemptuous smile on his face. The person in front of him really didn't know the heights of heaven and earth.
Defeat yourself? Is he worthy?
Not only Tang Qian, but also the elders on the peak felt that Xiao Nuo was overthinking.
Tang Qian's strength has reached the fifth level of the foundation building realm.
Not to mention the gap between the two of them, just because Xiao Nuo traveled a hundred and twenty miles across the mountain road and climbed the ladder to heaven, his physical strength was probably almost exhausted a long time ago.
If the other party was smarter, they wouldn't even think about taking action.
The right choice is to wait honestly for Zhou An and Liangzi to come, and then take third place.
